notes:
JAPANESE FISCAL YEAR:
Many Japanese companies end their fiscal year in March (⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧{決算|けっさん}), so February-March is a busy season for accountants.

- ⟦{決算報告|けっさんほうこく}→決算報告：25816_kessanhoukoku⟧: financial report
- ⟦{決算書|けっさんしょ}→決算書：19601_kessansho⟧: financial statements
